name: ppg-functions
description: Cloud Functions for the PPG BLE sync prototype (chunk analysis).

scripts.test:emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ppg --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:emulator-suite"
scripts.test:flutter-e2e: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ppg --only auth,firestore,functions "cd .. && flutter test --no-pub test_emulator"
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:emulators
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-ppg
